title: Gas-sensor drift classification: feature reweighting, temporal validation, and interpolation
description: Code, public-dataset copies, and reference predictions for chronological gas-sensor drift classification on the UCI drift trajectory and a separate 62-sensor dataset. Analyses compare index-ring feature summaries, temporal model selection, same-class interpolation controls, and a tabular ERM/CORAL adaptation. Code is MIT licensed; datasets and reference results are CC BY 4.0. Original dataset citations and third-party notices are included.
